intervals.label: VERITAS hosted at FLWO
intervals.note: Interval reflects when VERITAS itself began at this pre-existing observatory (founded 1968 as the Whipple 10m telescope site per public knowledge, not independently sourced); FLWO's own founding date is not recorded here.
intervals.quote: Installation of VERITAS prototype telescope at the FLWO Basecamp

name: Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory
notes: FLWO's own founding date (pre-dating VERITAS) is not sourced; only VERITAS-relevant intervals are recorded.

operator.note: VERITAS is supported by/hosted at the Smithsonian's Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory; the exact operator sentence names the Smithsonian Institution among the observatory's supporting bodies.

summary.plain: A mountain observatory in southern Arizona, home to the VERITAS gamma-ray telescopes among other instruments.
summary.technical: Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory site on Mount Hopkins, Arizona, at 1268 m altitude, hosting VERITAS since 2003.
